title: Create the domain verification aggregate and lifecycle
summary: Implemented tenant-bound domain verification challenges and append-only attempts for DNS TXT, HTML file, meta tag, and Search Console adapters, with exact-origin DB protection, secure derived proof material, lifecycle/rate/freshness policies, safe evidence, audits/outbox events, property projections, authorization-aware UI, and documentation.

tests.command: PASS: mise exec -- bin/quality (14/14); focused verification/properties/audit Rails tests (44 runs, 235 assertions); verification system test (1 run, 6 assertions); full Rails test (699 runs, 5382 assertions); full system test (34 runs, 162 assertions). One initial full-suite run had a transient pre-existing Identity timestamp error; isolated rerun passed (2 runs, 7 assertions) and the repeated full suite passed.
